title: Associate Industrial Designer - Lacrosse
note: Lacrosse equipment (sporting goods); asks for 1–3 years of experience.

facts.summary: Associate ID designing lacrosse heads, protective gear and accessories.
facts.duties: Takes products from research and sketches through 2D/3D development to production, and builds tech packs in Illustrator or SolidWorks.
facts.requirements: ID bachelor's, 1–3 years, Illustrator and SolidWorks, knowledge of injection molding and softgoods.
facts.apply: Apply on New Balance's Warrior Workday site.
